data.long_meaning: Steffie is a female variant of Stefan, which has Greek and Latin roots. Stefan means 'crown' or 'coronet'. In Christian tradition, the crown represents glory, victory, and divine favor. Steffie, as a feminine form of Stefan, symbolizes the divine favor and strength granted to women in the Christian faith. The name Steffie carries the meaning “Crown of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Steffie usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
